messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: Elevated 502/504 errors detected from edge-proxy cluster in us-west-2. Triggered by error-rate threshold (5m). Paging oncall.
oncall-sre: taking pager — pivoting to live dashboard. can someone grab recent nginx access logs? :eyes:
sam: pulling logs now from edge-proxy-0/1/2. I see a surge of upstream timeouts and a subset of 502s with 'upstream prematurely closed connection'.
jamie: looking at routing config — no recent deploys to edge-proxy. last deploy was 4h ago (deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T10:20Z -> edge-proxy v1.4.7)
oncall-sre: ok, start with quick customer impact check. product-ops, any user-facing alerts? we should check 5xx per-customer rate.
product-ops: getting customer impact. so far automated alerts show increased latency for a small portion of requests (~2% of traffic) and some timeouts on webhook deliveries.
leo: logs are sparse for some requests — looks like trace headers missing for a chunk of traffic. trace-collector has gaps for the last 10m. can we instrument a stopgap to add request-id header at the proxy? that would help correlate.
sam: agree. we can hotpatch edge-proxy config to inject X-RW-Temp-Reqid if absent, and increase access_log detail. patch would be a config reload only.
jamie: before a hotpatch, any chance this is a backend saturation issue? backend metrics show a slight CPU bump but not saturation.
oncall-sre: timeline: errors started 3865019800 (approx). Traces dropping ~3865019900.
leo: looks like our trace sampler dropped low-sampling for edge route. sampling service had a short GC pause around that time per infra metrics.
oncall-sre: root cause unknown yet. mitigation plan: 1) enable debug access logs on edge-proxy for 5m 2) inject temp request-id header for missing traces 3) increase trace-sampler memory limit and restart sampler if needed 4) route small % of traffic to fallback pool.
tara: I can apply the proxy config change to increase logs and add header. will do a dry-run and then reload. s3 backup exists.
sam: command I'll run:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap edge-proxy-config -p '{"data":{"add_temp_reqid":"true","access_log_level":"debug"}}'
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy
```
(sam uploads the config diff link: https://git.local/infra/edge-proxy/changes/888)
jamie: I'll stand by to flip traffic if logs show backend errors vs network errors.
oncall-sre: note: we need to preserve minimal latency — prefer config reload over full restart if possible. any reload endpoint?
sam: yes, edge-proxy supports dynamic reload via admin API. executing now.
deploy-bot: deploy log: config reload requested by sam on edge-proxy at 3865020001 — admin reload accepted.
sam: reload finished. debug access logging enabled. I added X-RW-Temp-Reqid header generation when header absent.
leo: I'm picking up new entries with temp reqids. tracing shows more spans now hitting collector but still a subset dropping between proxy and backend.
oncall-sre: can we enable additional logging on the ingress->backend path to see timeout reasons? maybe tcp-level metrics or upstream keepalive info.
tara: enabling upstream debug for 5m... toggling now.
jamie: backend team, any sudden thread/connection limits being hit? /cc @backend
leo: backend connection pool metrics show increased connection churn and socket reset count on a few nodes.
sam: hypothesis: an intermittent network blip between router fabric and specific backend AZ causing socket resets -> 502s.
product-ops: customer update draft: "We're investigating increased request errors for a small subset of traffic in us-west-2. We're actively mitigating and will provide updates within 30 minutes. No data loss expected." ok to send?
oncall-sre: yes, send with scope limited to us-west-2 edge-proxy impact. set severity P2.
product-ops: sent to status page and posted in #status-updates.
leo: as a stopgap, I suggest routing 10% of traffic away from the affected backend pool to a healthy pool in same region via traffic-split. jamie, can you flip that?
jamie: can do. Applying weighted routing change now.
```
# traffic manager
rwctl traffic-split set --route /api --region us-west-2 --weights pool-a:90,pool-b:10
```
jamie: change applied 3865020320.
oncall-sre: monitoring for 5m window. also keep debug logs for 10m and then revert to normal to avoid cost.
sam: logs show 502 rate down 60% on the affected nodes after split. good.
leo: trace collector memory climbed earlier — I bumped sampler's heap and restarted sampler to recover traces, sampler restart at 3865020500.
sam: after sampler restart, traces flow is restored for most requests. we have request-id propagation now so correlation is better.
oncall-sre: next steps: 1) keep routing weight change for 30m 2) retain debug logs for 10m then revert 3) follow up infra postmortem to address underlying network churn and make tracing more robust.
tara: I'll schedule the log revert and config cleanup commands to run in 10m as a rollback job.
jamie: leaving a temporary playbook entry in runbook: brief commands used, who touched them, and why.
product-ops: customer update sent: follow-up in 30m with causal analysis.
leo: recommend follow-up items: add fallback timeout and retry at proxy for specific upstream error codes, add circuit-breaker metrics to alert earlier.
oncall-sre: agreed. thanks all. handing back to normal oncall once we hit steady 10m.
product-ops: summary note for postmortem: "sparse traces + sampler GC pause + intermittent socket resets -> elevated 502s for a subset of traffic. Stopgaps: temp reqid injection, enable debug logs, sampler restart, traffic split. Customer communications sent." 
sam: arch note: consider short-term allocation bump to sampler and improve backpressure when collector unavailable.
jamie: I'll file a follow-up ticket for traffic manager automation to self-split on elevated 5xx patterns.
oncall-sre: incident marked mitigated at 3865021400. leaving thread open for postmortem items.
product-ops: thanks team, closing customer-facing update.
(reacts: :white_check_mark: from oncall-sre, :heart: from product-ops)
